items.title: Chris Parker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 5, 2023
items.q: I played with a guest artist on the show... there were a lot of people like Leo Sayer or Eric Clapton or Elvis Costello or Linda Ronstadt, Aaron Neville, where they didn’t have a band so they used a put together band from New York or they used certain members of the Saturday Night band itself to do

ctx.x: It’s a terrific answer. Thank you. When you got the call to play in the Saturday Night Live band was it a no-brainer to take it or was there something about committing every Saturday that gave you pause?

I considered it carefully because I was pretty busy at the time and they did say what are your weekends like. And I weighed the pros and cons about it and decided to take it because I hadn’t done it before. I had done guest shots on the show since the early 70s. You know I played with a guest artist on the show, which is relatively easy. I mean you rehearse with the artist during the week somewhere and then you come Saturday morning or Saturday afternoon and rehearse again in the studio and camera blocking and…
Anybody stand out — a particular show that comes to mind when someone like me asks about Saturday Night Live?
